project.name: Hospital Management System
project.summary: A system for patient registration, appointment scheduling, medical record access, doctor workflow, and admin billing.

functional_requirements: Patients can register and maintain a secure profile.
Patients can book, modify, and cancel appointments with doctors.
Patients can view their own medical history, diagnoses, and prescriptions.
Doctors can manage their appointment schedules and record diagnoses and prescriptions.
Administrators can manage departments, doctors, and patient billing.
non_functional_requirements: All patient data must be stored and transmitted securely with encryption.
The system shall respond to user actions within 2 seconds under normal load.
The system shall be available 99.9% uptime with failover capabilities.
The architecture shall support scaling to handle peak hospital loads.

actors.name: Patient
actors.description: Registers, books appointments, and accesses personal medical records.

actors.name: Doctor
actors.description: Manages schedule, records diagnoses, and writes prescriptions for patients.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Oversees departments, doctor accounts, and handles patient billing.

use_cases.name: Register Account
use_cases.description: Patient creates a new account with personal and contact information.

use_cases.name: Book Appointment
use_cases.description: Patient selects a doctor, chooses an available time slot, and confirms the appointment.

use_cases.name: View Medical History
use_cases.description: Patient accesses a list of past diagnoses, treatments, and prescriptions.

use_cases.name: Record Diagnosis and Prescription
use_cases.description: Doctor adds diagnosis details and prescription information to a patient’s record after an appointment.

use_cases.name: Manage Billing
use_cases.description: Administrator generates invoices, processes payments, and audits billing records.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can register and maintain a secure profile.
criteria: Registration requires email verification before activation.
Stored personal data is encrypted at rest.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can book, modify, and cancel appointments with doctors.
criteria: System prevents double‑booking of the same time slot.
Confirmation email is sent after booking.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Patients can view their own medical history, diagnoses, and prescriptions.
criteria: Only the logged‑in patient can access their records.
History displays chronologically with diagnosis and prescription details.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Doctors can manage their appointment schedules and record diagnoses and prescriptions.
criteria: Doctor can add, edit, or delete appointments in their schedule.
Recorded diagnosis and prescription are linked to the specific appointment.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Administrators can manage departments, doctors, and patient billing.
criteria: Admin can generate a billing invoice for a patient visit.
All billing actions are logged for audit purposes.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to register an account, so that I can access the hospital system securely.
acceptance_criteria: Patient can create an account with email and password.
System validates required fields and stores encrypted credentials.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to book appointments with doctors, so that I can receive timely care.
acceptance_criteria: Patient can view available time slots for selected doctor.
Appointment is confirmed and added to both patient and doctor schedules.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to view my medical history, so that I can stay informed about my health.
acceptance_criteria: Patient can access a list of past visits, diagnoses, and prescriptions.
Data is displayed only after successful authentication.

user_stories.story: As a doctor, I want to manage my appointment schedule, so that I can organize my patient visits efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor can view, add, modify, and cancel appointments in their calendar.
Changes are reflected in real-time for patients attempting to book.

user_stories.story: As a doctor, I want to record diagnoses and write prescriptions, so that patients receive appropriate treatment.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor can enter diagnosis details and select medications from a formulary.
Prescriptions are saved to the patient’s record and can be viewed by the patient.

user_stories.story: As an administrator, I want to manage departments, doctors, and patient billing, so that the hospital operates smoothly.
acceptance_criteria: Administrator can add, edit, or remove departments and assign doctors to them.
Administrator can generate and update billing records for patients.

    HMS-->>D: ScheduleData

A doctor can have many appointments
An appointment can generate multiple prescriptions

Database Designer.sql:
CREATE TABLE Patients (
    patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT,
    dob DATETIME,
    phone TEXT,
    address TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE Doctors (
    doctor_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT,
    specialty TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    phone TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE Appointments (
    appointment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    patient_id INTEGER,
    doctor_id INTEGER,
    appointment_time DATETIME,
    status TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES Patients(patient_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id) REFERENCES Doctors(doctor_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Prescriptions (
    prescription_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    appointment_id INTEGER,
    medication TEXT,
    dosage TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES Appointments(appointment_id)
);

Project Structure.architecture: Microservice‑style monorepo with separate React/Vite SPA, FastAPI REST API, PostgreSQL for relational data, Redis for caching, Docker for container orchestration, and Nginx as reverse proxy and load balancer. JWT secures API endpoints; role‑based access controls separate patient, doctor, and admin capabilities.

flowchart TD
    subgraph Client
        UI[React SPA]
    end
    subgraph API
        FastAPI[FastAPI Service]
    end
    subgraph DB
        Postgres[(PostgreSQL)]
        Redis[(Redis Cache)]
    end
    subgraph Infra
        Nginx[Nginx Reverse Proxy]
        Docker[Docker Compose]
    end
    UI -->|HTTPS| Nginx
    Nginx -->|Proxy| FastAPI
    FastAPI -->|SQL| Postgres
    FastAPI -->|Cache| Redis
    Docker -->|Orchestrates| Nginx
    Docker -->|Orchestrates| FastAPI
    Docker -->|Orchestrates| Postgres
    Docker -->|Orchestrates| Redis

Documentation.readme: Hospital Management System (HMS) enables patient registration, appointment booking, medical history viewing, doctor schedule management, diagnosis recording, prescription writing, and admin control of departments, staff, and billing. Built with a RESTful API, React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and PostgreSQL database. Emphasizes data security, low latency, and 99.9% uptime.
Documentation.api_documentation: POST /patients – register; GET /patients/{id} – profile; GET /patients/{id}/history – medical history. POST /appointments – book; GET /doctors/{id}/schedule – view schedule; PUT /appointments/{id} – update status. POST /diagnoses – record; POST /prescriptions – create. Admin: GET/POST/PUT /departments, /doctors, /billing. All endpoints require JWT auth, role‑based access.
Documentation.installation: Clone repo, run `npm install` in server and client directories. Set up PostgreSQL, run `psql -f schema.sql`. Create .env with DB_URL, JWT_SECRET, and PORT. Run `npm run start` for backend and `npm run start` for frontend.
Documentation.deployment: Containerize with Docker; use docker-compose to launch db, api, and web services. Deploy to a cloud VM or Kubernetes cluster behind an NGINX reverse proxy with TLS. Enable health checks and auto‑restart policies.
Documentation.sprint_plan: Sprint 1: Core patient registration & auth. Sprint 2: Appointment booking & doctor schedule UI. Sprint 3: Diagnosis, prescription, and medical history APIs. Sprint 4: Admin module for departments, doctors, billing. Sprint 5: Security hardening, performance testing, CI/CD pipeline.
Documentation.architecture: Three‑tier: React SPA (frontend) → Node.js/Express REST API (business logic) → PostgreSQL (data). JWT for stateless auth, role‑based middleware. Docker containers isolate services. NGINX load balancer provides HTTPS and failover. Monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana.
